stories.label: Still waiting · India · Due process
stories.head: Umar Khalid
bullets: Held under UAPA since 13 Sep 2020; trial not begun.
Delhi HC refused bail a third time on 30 Sep; he has moved the Supreme Court.
Delhi Police call fresh bail pleas premature.
stories.caption: He and Sharjeel Imam have taken their bail pleas to the Supreme Court, saying the trial has not begun. Source: UNI

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi, where Umar Khalid has now sought bail, in 2019.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Expression
stories.head: Najmeh Amini
bullets: Sentenced to death for blasphemy over social media posts, plus 12.5 years.
stories.src: Center for Human Rights in Iran · Hengaw
stories.caption: Rights groups report she is held in Mashhad's Vakilabad prison. Source: Center for Human Rights in Iran

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Press
stories.head: Satyam Verma
bullets: Journalist held since 17 Apr 2026; NSA order 12 May.
Got bail in one case on 15 Sep but stays held under the NSA.
UP Police allege a major role in protest violence.
stories.caption: The High Court reserved its verdict on his NSA challenge on 8 Oct; no judgment has been reported. Source: LiveLaw

photo.alt: A large cream stone court building with a pediment, red-tiled roofs and an Indian flag, behind lawns and potted plants.
photo.caption: The Allahabad High Court in Prayagraj, which reserved its verdict on Verma's NSA challenge on 8 Oct, in 2009.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Zied el-Heni
bullets: Journalist held since 24 Apr 2026, serving one year.
Given four more years on terrorism-related charges on 27 Oct.
17 groups urged his release; no official response reported.
stories.caption: The new sentence relates to his report on a leaked audio recording. Source: Africanews (AFP)

photo.alt: A wide paved promenade lined with clipped trees, with people walking and yellow taxis at the side.
photo.caption: Avenue Habib Bourguiba in central Tunis, in 2015.

hope_caption: Four Siang villagers held under Arunachal's anti-terror law were freed after 29 days, and Kaziranga activist Pranab Doley left jail after 118 days; six Siang protesters remain held. Source: ThePrint (PTI) · Indian Express
